findings.title: Homepage Canonical Trailing Slash Mismatch with Sitemap
findings.description: app/page.tsx declares alternates.canonical as 'https://shahoriar.bd/', whereas app/sitemap.ts emits 'https://shahoriar.bd' without trailing slash. This discrepancy causes search engines to evaluate two canonical candidates.
findings.recommendation: Remove the trailing slash in app/page.tsx to match sitemap.xml ('https://shahoriar.bd').

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tag on /techtips and /ide
findings.description: app/techtips/layout.tsx and app/ide/page.tsx do not declare an alternates.canonical URL, leaving query strings or trailing slashes vulnerable to duplicate indexing.
findings.recommendation: Add alternates: { canonical: 'https://shahoriar.bd/techtips' } to app/techtips/layout.tsx and alternates: { canonical: 'https://shahoriar.bd/ide' } to app/ide/page.tsx (or mark /ide with robots noindex if private).

findings.title: Crawl Isolation Gaps for Standalone Routes in robots.txt
findings.description: Internal and private apps (/shoily, /bizcomp, /meetup) are excluded from the sitemap but not disallowed in robots.txt. /meetup also contains an unencoded replacement character in its title.
findings.recommendation: Add Disallow rules in app/robots.ts for /shoily, /bizcomp, and /meetup, or ensure they explicitly carry robots: { index: false }.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Firsthand expertise and institutional affiliations (EY Bangladesh, bKash, ICAB, BUP)
Zero filler content, zero detected AI generic pattern phrasing (overall quality score: 91/100)
External authority backlinks and citations to official BUP news and business press
Detailed statutory compliance architecture for Bangladesh Youth Tax Calculator

findings.title: Duplicate H1 Tags on Blog Detail Pages
findings.description: In app/life/[slug]/page.tsx, the article title renders as an <h1>, but the Contentful rich text renderer also maps BLOCKS.HEADING_1 to an <h1>. Any post containing a top-level heading in Contentful has multiple <h1> elements.
findings.recommendation: Change BLOCKS.HEADING_1 in the rich text renderNode to render an <h2>, BLOCKS.HEADING_2 to <h3>, and BLOCKS.HEADING_3 to <h4>.

findings.title: Homepage H1 Text Concatenation
findings.description: In app/components/HeroSection.tsx, the <h1> includes both an sr-only span with the full name and visual block spans with the name split. Search engines concatenate these into 'Md Al Shahoriar HossainMD ALSHAHORIARHossain'.
findings.recommendation: Provide visual text within standard spans and avoid duplicating the entire name in an adjacent sr-only container inside the same <h1>.

findings.title: Heading Level Skips on /projects and /design-portfolio
findings.description: app/projects/ProjectsContent.tsx skips from <h1> directly to <h3> without any intermediate <h2>. /design-portfolio lacks an <h1> element entirely, starting at <h2>.
findings.recommendation: Add section <h2> headings on /projects and add an <h1> page header on /design-portfolio.

categories.name: On-Page SEO

Targeted keywords mapped to specific projects (Youth Tax Calculator, Tapo-Viewer, LocReminder)
Clear hierarchy and semantic sectioning across desktop and mobile shells

findings.title: Missing Page-Level Open Graph and Twitter Metadata on 7 Key Routes
findings.description: /skills, /education, /projects, /life, /ai, /contact, and /design-portfolio do not define openGraph or twitter card metadata. When shared on social platforms, they fallback to generic homepage text.
findings.recommendation: Export specific openGraph and twitter objects in the metadata of each page with customized titles, descriptions, and canonical URLs.

findings.title: Buried Resume & Recruiter Friction (SXO)
findings.description: The primary conversion goal for a professional portfolio is employer and recruiter evaluation. The resume (/resume.md) is buried under the bottom AI profile section rather than in the primary navigation or Hero CTA.
findings.recommendation: Add a direct 'Resume' link in app/components/nav.tsx and a secondary CTA button in HeroSection.

findings.title: Missing ContactPage and Credential Structured Data
findings.description: /contact lacks ContactPage / ContactPoint schema. /skills certifications tab does not provide EducationalOccupationalCredential or ItemList schema.
findings.recommendation: Inject ContactPage schema on /contact and ItemList / EducationalOccupationalCredential markup on /skills.

findings.title: Deprecated FAQPage SERP Feature Advisory
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich result accordions for all sites on May 7, 2026. Existing FAQPage markup on homepage and /projects/youth-tax-calculator provides no SERP accordion benefits.
findings.recommendation: Retain existing FAQ schema for AI entity understanding, but do not rely on it for Google SERP snippet expansion.

Deferred third-party tracking (Microsoft Clarity initializes on requestIdleCallback / 3s timeout)
Priority loading on desktop hero portrait and responsive next/image optimization

findings.title: Absence of Speculation Rules and fetchpriority="high"
findings.description: preload_check.py scored 50/100. While Next.js provides client router prefetching, adding Speculation Rules API enables instant prerendering for top user pathways (/skills, /projects, /ai).
findings.recommendation: Add a <script type="speculationrules"> block in layout.tsx or next.config.js headers, and ensure hero images carry fetchpriority="high".

categories.name: AI Search Readiness

Permanent llms.txt and llms-full.txt links advertised via HTTP Link headers
100/100 score on agent_ux_check.py (semantic landmarks, accessible controls, zero div-onclick widgets)
Open robots policy allowing all major AI search crawlers (GPTBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Applebot)

findings.title: llms.txt Fails Official Specification & Lighthouse Agentic Audit
findings.description: agentic_check.py flagged llms.txt as failing Lighthouse Agentic criteria: missing blockquote summary ('> ...') and using bare text URLs instead of Markdown formatted links [Name](url).
findings.recommendation: Rewrite app/llms.txt/route.ts to include a blockquote summary below the title and format all links as markdown links with concise descriptions.

findings.title: 40+ App Logos with Empty alt="" on /techtips
findings.description: ItemCard in app/techtips/page.tsx renders images with alt="", treating all software and tool logos as decorative images.
findings.recommendation: Update ItemCard to use alt={`${item.name} logo`} for accessible identification and image search indexing.

findings.title: External Free Image Hosting (i.ibb.co.com)
findings.description: EY company logo on /skills and Tapo-Viewer screenshots load from i.ibb.co.com, introducing third-party DNS latency and link expiration risk.
findings.recommendation: Download and host all images locally in public/skills/ and public/projects/tapo-viewer/.
